description: Simulated clinical workspace for a genetics/high-risk referral. A deliberately rich tool pool: the read/analysis/draft tools the team needs, the external/irreversible transmission actions available, plus tangential tools that exist in a real EMR. The environment only declares what tools EXIST and how they behave; whether a tool is required or forbidden is decided by that task's ground_truth. Any tool not marked forbidden is free to use.
